Priya (partnerships): Heads-up: ThermoTech reported 0 usage for several on-prem units during 2026-03-18 14:00-15:00 UTC after a firmware push. They sent sample webhook ids and raw payloads.
MeterBot: alert: marketplace_event_format_change: partner=thermotech new_ts_format=epoch_s detected_by=ingest_parser
Hugo (eng-partnerships): Looking at ingestion logs: events arrived but our parser expected RFC3339 with timezone. Firmware now sends unix seconds (no ms). Our dedupe/aggregation pipeline ignored them because event_id normalization failed.
Mei (billing): If we replay without marking, invoices will double-count later. We need replay_id and ledger.source=backfill on replay rows. Also hold invoices for affected hours until reconciled.
Raj (infra): Quick fixes: 1) add tolerant timestamp parser to accept epoch seconds and RFC3339 (feature-flagged per partner), 2) emit metric ingest.event_ts_format.partner=thermotech to detect future changes, 3) route unknown-format events to quarantine for manual review.
Priya (partnerships): ThermoTech prefers server-side fixes. They approved tolerant parsing as long as we don't change their payloads. They want notification when backfill completes.
Hugo (eng-partnerships): I'll open a small PR to add parser + feature flag `ts_flex_thermotech`. Also will add replay metadata: {"billing.replay":"true","billing.replay_id":"<uuid>","ledger.source":"backfill"}.
Raj (infra): I'll add a lightweight probe that samples incoming timestamp formats and emits a counter per format. Alert if unknown formats > 1% in 10m.
Mei (billing): Billing checklist: attach replay_id to billing_events, mark invoices intersecting affected window as provisional, send reconciliation_report.csv to partner and include replay_id. Threshold for customer notice is $3.
Hugo (eng-partnerships): Staging dry-run command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/internal/replay \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STG_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"partner":"thermotech","events":["a1b2c3"],"dry_run":true}'
```
MeterBot: action: dry_run_job dr-2643201300 created by hugo
Priya (partnerships): Owners & ETA: Hugo PR + staging dry run (ETA 3h), Raj probe & metric (ETA 6h), Mei billing hold & report template (ETA EOD). I'll inform ThermoTech and request sign-off for targeted replay.
Hugo (eng-partnerships): No objections. Will include idempotency key normalization to ignore ms vs s differences.
Priya (partnerships): Great — posting replay_id here when queued.
